headline: Kenya to Provide Free School Meals Nationwide Starting 2027
meta_description: Kenya's president orders free nationwide school meals from Term 1, 2027, covering primary and junior secondary students as part of social protection effort.
summary_short: Kenya will launch a free school meal programme across the country in 2027, reaching learners in lower primary, upper primary, and junior secondary schools.
body:
Kenya will provide free school meals to learners nationwide starting in Term 1, 2027, President Ruto has announced. The programme will cover students in lower primary, upper primary, and junior secondary schools across the country.

The initiative aims to strengthen social protection and support poor and vulnerable families. By extending meals to three distinct school levels, the government seeks to address both nutrition and educational access for Kenya's most at-risk students.

This nationwide rollout represents a significant commitment to removing barriers that keep children from attending school, particularly in economically disadvantaged regions. The timing—beginning in 2027's first term—signals a structured, planned approach to implementation.
quick_facts: Free meals begin Term 1, 2027 across Kenya
Covers lower primary, upper primary, junior secondary
Aims to support poor and vulnerable families
Part of wider social protection effort
